edb: SELECT indicator_code AS field, observation_date::text AS observation_date, published_date::text AS published_date, value::float8 AS value FROM public.edb WHERE indicator_code = ANY($1::text[]) AND observation_date >= $2::date - interval '540 days' AND observation_date < $3::date ORDER BY indicator_code, observation_date
quant_input: SELECT field, observation_date::text AS observation_date, numeric_value::float8 AS value FROM public.quant_input WHERE field = ANY($1::text[]) AND observation_date >= $2::date - interval '60 days' AND observation_date < $3::date ORDER BY field, observation_date
curve_days: SELECT DISTINCT observation_date::text AS observation_date FROM public.bond_industry_curve WHERE curve_code = $1 AND observation_date < $2::date ORDER BY 1
curve_at: SELECT observation_date::text AS observation_date, tenor_years::float8 AS tenor_years, yield_pct::float8 AS yield_pct FROM public.bond_industry_curve WHERE curve_code = $1 AND observation_date = ANY($2::date[]) ORDER BY observation_date, tenor_years
issuer_events: SELECT bond_code, bond_type, tender_date::text AS tender_date, tender_announcement_date::text AS tender_announcement_date, original_tenor_years::float8 AS tenor, final_coupon_pct::float8 AS coupon, issue_amount_100m::float8 AS amount, bond_rating FROM public.bond_issuance WHERE issuer_name = $1 AND bond_type = ANY($2::text[]) AND interest_rate_type LIKE '固%' AND has_option IS FALSE AND placement_type = '公募' AND final_coupon_pct IS NOT NULL AND tender_date IS NOT NULL AND bond_rating IS NOT NULL AND pricing_invalid_code IS NOT TRUE AND quarantine_final_coupon_pct IS NULL AND quarantine_tender_date IS NULL AND tender_date < $3::date ORDER BY tender_date DESC, bond_code LIMIT 60
issuer_bonds: SELECT o.valuation_date::text AS date, o.bond_code AS code, o.chinabond_yield_pct::float8 AS y, o.outstanding_balance_cny::float8 AS bal, o.remaining_term_years::float8 AS term FROM public.bond_history_observations($1::date[]) o JOIN public.bond_issuance i ON o.bond_code = public.exchange_bond_code(i.bond_code) WHERE i.issuer_name = $2 AND i.bond_type = ANY($3::text[]) AND i.interest_rate_type LIKE '固%' ORDER BY 1, 2
